carla.mendes: heads-up — new HF model conversion failing on Redwood runtime after quantize smoke tests. generation output is mangled and we get kv cache errors in the logs.
ben.ortiz: which errors? stack + snippet pls.
carla.mendes: IndexError in runtime: "kv index 1024 out of range (max 1023)". happens after ~1.5k tokens. conversion log shows config.json: 
```json
{
  "num_key_value_heads": 8,
  "num_attention_heads": 16,
  "max_position_embeddings": 20480,
  "rope_scaling": {"type":"linear", "factor": 1.0},
  "sliding_window": 128
}
```
carla.mendes: note HF left sliding_window as an int meaning window size; our converter expects boolean or explicit "mode". also num_key_value_heads is missing the per-head mapping so runtime computed kv_index = head_idx * kv_head_size + offset and went OOB.
convert-bot: conversion job 1864012345 started for model company/new-chatxl-1. quantization: 4bit.
alice.chen: ah — HF often represents sliding_window differently across families. some configs use "sliding_window": true/false, others an int for window length. our converter treated 128 as a truthy flag but then set runtime sliding window length to default 1024, causing kv offset misalignment when we repacked KV cache shards.
dave_k: also max_position_embeddings=20480 will get trun cated by runtime if hardware cap is 2048 — that mismatch can shift position ids and break rope scaling if our converter doesn't normalize rope_scaling into the runtime's expected schema.
ben.ortiz: quick triage plan: 1) validate converter to assert num_key_value_heads divides num_attention_heads or map appropriately. 2) normalize sliding_window: if integer -> interpret as length, else bool. 3) clamp max_position_embeddings to runtime max and emit warning. 4) add a runtime check that kv_index < kv_capacity with clear error message and diagnostic payload.
carla.mendes: doing step 1 now — small patch to force kv_heads = num_attention_heads if num_key_value_heads absent or < 1. local run shows earlier IndexError goes away but generation still weird (pos id drift).
ben.ortiz: paste the patch?
carla.mendes: ```diff
- kv_heads = cfg.get("num_key_value_heads", 8)
+ kv_heads = cfg.get("num_key_value_heads") or cfg.get("num_attention_heads")
```
alice.chen: good. for rope_scaling we need to remap HF's object into our runtime tuple form: HF uses {type,factor,init} sometimes. we should canonicalize to {"type":...,"scale_over_max_pos":...}. i pushed a converter helper and unit tests.
dave_k: FYI I repro'd the max_pos truncation: HF model advertises 20480, tokenizer still uses 20480 so tokenization of long contexts differs from runtime which clamps to 2048. result: prompts get chopped mid-prompt and chat template injection duplications.
ben.ortiz: that explains the double system prompt reports. talk through mitigation: converter should rewrite tokenizer.json to include a "redwood_max_pos" field and we should emit a QA warning: "model max_position_embeddings > runtime_limit -> trimmed to X; run evals with trimmed context".
carla.mendes: opened PR #5123 with three changes: kv_heads fallback, sliding_window normalization, rope_scaling canonicalizer. failing test was the tokenization + eval regression; added an eval that compares outputs between HF CPU run (clamped) and Redwood runtime to catch positional drift. link: https://git.internal/redwood/conv/PR-5123
convert-bot: PR #5123 created by carla.mendes — CI queued.
alice.chen: can we also add a quick converter flag --force-max-pos to let eng QA simulate higher max_pos via chunked attention (temporary) so we can validate long-context behavior?
ben.ortiz: yes, but doc the perf and cache tradeoffs. make the flag explicit: --force-max-pos=<N> will enable chunked attention emulation and expanded kv index layout.
dave_k: note for release notes: describe the error message change from generic IndexError to "kv_index OOB — config mismatch (num_key_value_heads vs num_attention_heads)" and recommend running converter validation before onboard.
carla.mendes: CI passed on tiny job. rolling a canary conversion and smoke quant tests now. will report back with eval diffs but initial sign is green (no OOB, and chat formatting fixed). :thumbsup:
ben.ortiz: awesome. if you hit anything else ping me @alice.chen for tokenization quirks.
carla.mendes: will do. saving logs + converter debug dump in casefile: s3://redwood/onboard/1864012345/debug.tar.gz
convert-bot: conversion job 1864012345 completed (canary). artifacts: s3://redwood/onboard/1864012345/artifacts/
carla.mendes: final note: this one was a combo failure — mismatched kv head count + implicit sliding_window semantics + huge max_pos. all three combined to create the visible regressions. PR includes better diagnostics so future onboarding should be faster.
ben.ortiz: perfect, thanks! :rocket:
